name: Tracked Loader
instructions: omr/instructions/42094-1-1.pdf (one book, the loader only; the functions are shown on pages 136-137)

functions.does: The rear one of the two black gear knobs on top of the engine cover raises and lowers the arm: its upright shaft turns a long shaft forward under the turntable to a linear actuator, which pushes the arm up.
functions.source: book: steps 9-11 (the knob shafts), 19-24 (the actuator, red boxes on pages 14 and 16), page 37 (cross-section of the drive), steps 170-178 (the arm), page 136 (the arm's arc and the knob's arrow)

functions.does: The front one of the two knobs on top turns the cab right round on its turntable: a 12 tooth gear at the foot of its shaft drives the turntable's teeth.
functions.source: book: step 15 (the turntable), steps 9-11 (the knob shafts), page 37 (cross-section), step 138 (the cab fitted on the turntable), page 137 (the 360 degree inset); which knob does which is inferred from the model's gears

functions.does: The black gear knob on the left side at the back winds the winch drum in the rear, reeling the cable and hook in or letting them out.
functions.source: book: steps 33-36 (the drum and its string), 37-53 (the gears beside it), page 136 (the knob's arrow and the cable's double arrow)

functions.does: The red lever on top at the back shifts a driving ring between two gears on the winch knob's shaft, giving the winch a fast and a slow speed, with a free middle position where the cable can be pulled out by hand.
functions.source: inferred: book step 53 (the red changeover catch, red box) and page 136 (the lever's arrow); the book doesn't say what the positions do, so the two speeds and the free middle are read from the gears (20 to 12 teeth one way, 16 to 16 the other)

functions.does: The grab on the end of the arm closes on the log: the black gear on its side turns the upper clamp down onto the lower tines.
functions.source: book: steps 162-164 (the gears in the grab, red box on page 95), page 136 (the grab's arrow), page 137 (the gear in the photo); which part closes on which is inferred
functions.note: unsure whether the gear tilts the whole grab or only closes the upper clamp

functions.does: The armrest consoles beside the seat, carrying the control levers, tip up on hinges at the back of the cab.
functions.source: inferred: page 136 (the arrow at the cab's side); the two consoles are built at steps 115-137

functions.does: The two tracks roll freely round their sprockets as the loader is pushed along.
functions.source: book: steps 179-218 (the track frames and tracks)

functions.does: Each track's raised front idler sits on a sprung arm, held out by a small shock absorber.
functions.source: book: steps 179-180 (the shock absorbers in the track frames)
functions.skip: a spring only matters under force
